CustomField.description: Deprecated. This checkbox has no effect. To control slow-action logging for the actions registered under this trigger setting, use Performance Threshold (ms) on this trigger setting. Leave it blank to follow Log Setting. Set a number to log every run that takes that many milliseconds or longer, even when Enable Trigger Performance Logging is off in Log Setting. Set a very high number to stop those entries.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Deprecated: this checkbox has no effect. Use Performance Threshold (ms) instead. Blank follows Log Setting. A number logs every run of the actions under this trigger setting that takes that long or longer, even when Enable Trigger Performance Logging is off in Log Setting. A very high number stops those entries.
CustomField.label: Enable Performance Logging (Deprecated)
